name: AskCount
lead: What one kind of ask has cost this pack, and what every kind has together. An ask is a question the engine puts to a pack with a deadline on it; an answer that does not arrive in time is not used.

fields.name: asks
fields.description: Questions the engine put to this pack.

fields.name: missed
fields.description: Deadlines that passed with no answer.

fields.name: late
fields.description: Answers that arrived after the engine had acted, and were dropped.

fields.name: skipped
fields.description: Asks never sent, because this kind is switched off for this pack.

fields.name: disabled
fields.description: True once the engine has stopped asking this pack this kind at all.

title: AskCount type
